en: A sepia-toned postcard showing a rural church complex behind a low stone wall. A large tree dominates the center foreground, partially obscuring the main church building with a steep gabled roof and whitewashed walls. To the right stands a small white arched gatehouse or chapel-like structure forming an entrance in the wall. Handwritten text in Swedish appears along the bottom margin, and printed text is faintly visible at the lower left.
